# A17-S05: Model expectations

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Glad you wrote. I check my mail way too often these weeks :-) Hopefully my contract can be recycled somewhat in the future.

Interesting about Bolander! It says a lot that we're now at a point where companies actively choose not to be represented by AI. The technology is so convincing that you only realize later it can't quite just replace humans. I am also very curious about how Julina will actually express herself, because it's unpredictable and a little magical what happens after I press the 'train button'. Right now I'm trying to prepare some frameworks so we are ready for a bit of everything :-)

Let's have a meeting when the contract is signed – also gladly with [████]!
